text:
owen: Quick sync — can we get marlin-7b-open into the catalog for next week's launch? Owners: @margo perf, @kevin infra, @priyanka legal. Blockers I see: license OK, perf profile (quantized + fp16), canary endpoint, and model card. Timeline: want a canary by Thu.

margo: I'm running perf on staging (4xA10). Short take: FP16 seq=32 p50 ~42ms/token, p95 ~110ms. Quantized INT8 run looks promising but need perf profile across sequence lengths. I'll push a perf artifact by EOD Wed.

kevin: infra needs artifacts in hf & torch.pt, and an s3 path with model card + spec. Also need recommended batch_size and max_seq. Can you drop artifacts to s3://redwood-models/marlin-7b-open/staging?

owen: I'll upload the artifacts today. For fallback, we can route to marlin-3b-compat if license blocks marlin-7b-open.

priyanka: license quick note — repo has an "Apache-2.0 WITH non-commercial" header. That's a problem for hosted catalog. I flagged it and asked the upstream to clarify. ETA for response unknown. If they don't remove non-commercial, we can't list it in hosted public catalog (private/dedicated ok with legal review).

margo: if license can't be cleared, can we still produce perf profiles for private/dedicated? I can, but we need to mark model visibility accordingly in the catalog metadata.

kevin: provisioning canary pool: I'll spin up a 2-GPU canary on dedicated pool and attach a temporary route. curl test endpoint once uploaded:

```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDSK\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"marlin-7b-open\",\"input\":\"hello\"}' \
  https://staging-infer.redwood.internal/v1/generate
```

catalog-bot: ingestion job queued: job_id=ingest-2076543210-01. Will report artifact checksum and ingest status in thread.

margo: perf artifacts will include: latency table (1,4,8,16,32), memory breakdown, recommended quant profile, and token throughput. I'll attach links here when done.

owen: action items — @margo produce perf artifact by Wed EOD; @kevin set up canary & provide endpoint; @priyanka confirm license or advise visibility change; catalog-bot post ingest status. If legal blocks, we'll switch route to marlin-3b-compat for public launch.

kevin: noted. I'll also add a rollout policy: canary traffic 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h if perf stable.

priyanka: FYI I've asked for a CLA/contact. If they sign a waiver we can proceed. Will update.

owen: cool — thanks everyone. ping here when uploads/ingest complete. :thumbsup:
